description: A port of the original Bedrock addon to Java. Made for Clearoom 1.12.2

releases.notes: Note that you will now need to download [RiftLibrary](https://github.com/Rift-Modding-Group/RiftLibrary/releases/tag/1.0.0), alongside [MixinBooter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-booter) as usual, in order for this mod to work. # Introducing RiftLibrary! RiftLibrary is a fork of the 1.12.2 version GeckoLib that has some additional features. As of now, these include: * Dynamic hitboxes (that can move with animations) * Dynamic player riding positions * Actual support for projectiles * UI API More will eventually come soon depending on the needs of Prehistoric Rift (as well as any other mod i might make) in the near future. # Added Tenontosaurus * Completely new model! * Spawn in Dark Forests * Unlike on Bedrock, Tenontosauruses can now only hypnotize monsters and bugs, but in exchange they're permanent (until the Tenontosaurus that hypnotized them gets dismissed or dies) * Besides hypnosis, they have access to any of the following moves: * Poison Powder (applies poison) * Paralysis Powder (applies paralysis, which makes those afflicted unable to move) * Sleeping Powder (applies drowsiness, which makes those afflicted move and break blocks slower) * Rage Powder (applies rage, which causes mobs to attack nearby mobs) * Itching Powder (causes mobs to lose half their current health) # Changes to Moves * Move cooldowns are now saved to NBT, so that summoning and dismissing them or exiting and opening the world cannot be abused to reset cooldown timers * Some moves can be executed outside of the context of combat: this means that creatures no longer need to be in combat to use certain moves # Changes and Additions to the Journal Besides cleaning up the code, there's also some new features: * Entries are now sorted into 2 tabs, being their entry (just their text) and their information (like diet, favorite food, favorite meals, taming method). * Changed journal entries to be more akin to Pokédex entries. * Added a search function. You can now search for specific entries!!! # Changes and Additions to Party and Box system Besides cleaning up the code, there's also some changes and new features * Removed all the upgrades * The UIs for the Journal and Party are completely different now * Added an overlay in the left sidebar where you can see your party (so you no longer need to press J to manually summon and dismiss them there). You can change selected creature with up and down keys and summon and dismiss selected creature with "K" (can be changed) * You can now see the moves of a creature from the party UI, and even change them there * The party now has a max of 6 creatures, which can no longer be changed * Reworked how Creature Box stores creatures. The Creature Box is divided into (as of now) 10 boxes, with each being able to hold up to 20 creatures, allowing you to hold up to 200 creatures (as of now) * You can now search creatures stored within your Creature Box * Creature Box summoning is now based on surrounding chunks instead of a radius. Creatures will now be spawned within a 5 x 5 chunk range of a Creature Box when summoned through them. Players can no longer place another creature box within the range of a creature box or in points where the ranges of two Creature Boxes could conflict * A player can only place up to 5 creature boxes at a time, and if they reach said limit, cannot place any more (max number can be configured tho) * You can now see the moves of a creature from the Creature Box UI (but they cant be changed there) # Other Changes * Added udders to Megaloceros model because why not (to signify that it can be milked) * Improvements to pathfinding for aquatic creatures * Brought back the ability to make creatures break blocks when being ridden using moves, with some changes ...

releases.notes:
Yet another big update, this time focusing on a rework to creature abilities, aka the move system! As always you will need [Geckolib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/4020277) for 1.12.2 and [MixinBooter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-booter) for the mod to work. Additionally, there's a good chance this will not work well with worlds made prior to this version.

# Moves
![2025-05-25_21 13 33](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e1252e9f-5652-407b-bde2-0f635c1bda4b)
The move system is basically a new system that makes adding of abilities for individual creatures much more easier (for me at least). This will be expanded upon in a later update where creature abilities can be changed.

For now, all creatures have 3 moves, ranging from attack related to utility related. All these moves are either new or old ones based on the old abilities of the creatures. These moves are all associated with the left click, right click, and middle click buttons, and they are now marked on the lower right section of the screen when riding a creature.

# Added Gallimimus
![2025-05-19_18 17 17](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f3f51553-0cbb-450b-a020-9aa9841e07f2)
* Found in Savannah biomes
* Are extremely skittish and will run away (unless you approach them while sneaking)
* Can be tamed with herbivore meals
* Have three moves:
  * Headbutt (does no damage)
  * Leap (leaps a pretty big distance forward)
  * Kick (kicks to do lots of knockback but no damage)

# Other Changes
* Reworked energy system
  * Movement no longer reduces energy
  * Sprinting while riding a creature finally works, but it uses energy
  * Most single use creature moves will no longer consume energy, but some (like Lunge or those that involve charging) will still use a charge up dependent amount of energy
* Some bug fixes and improvements
* Removed Herobrine

* Tamed Megaloceros can be milked :trollface:

releases.notes:
This was one huge update in the making. This time though you will need [Geckolib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/4020277) for 1.12.2 and [MixinBooter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-booter) for the mod to work. Yes that's right, LLibrary is no longer needed, but in exchange it uses mixins.

# Rifted Stone Mounds
![2025-01-13_19 58 42](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/481589c5-f9b6-478b-a2f9-2d0e2e652cad)
These mysterious mounds of purple stone may contain ores of what are known as Rift Shards, which are purple crystals important for crafting some important items.

# Creature Party
![2025-01-13_19 18 35](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d997963-cfab-4d99-b89d-1dbf8a624867)
The Journal screen now has an extra tab, that shows all creatures that can accompany you. These creatures can be summoned or dismissed at will too. The maximum amount of creatures you can carry with you in your party is 4, but this can be upgraded to up to 12 with this upgrade item:
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e02da2af-9833-4486-808e-097354fdff2a)

# Creature Box (and Box Wandering)
![2024-12-14_22 40 12](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4df80ef1-5b96-456a-8d32-524f515da6c9)
When your party is full and you keep taming more creatures, they will end up in your box. To see what creatures are in your box, you will need to craft a Creature Box as shown:
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f7b4ace7-60a0-47c3-a03d-39b97c028394)
![2025-01-13_19 43 29](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/990e4980-17e0-4c14-b629-4e0cec6fb595)

Note that you can have up to 80 creatures stored in your box, which can be upgraded up to 160 with the following item:
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/72241ba0-3b49-4075-9aaa-7d4c644b4725)

You can also make creatures wander around a creature box. Creatures wandering around a creature box can:
* Be set to turret mode (if they can)
* Have their workstations set/cleared (which they will work on)
* Harvest blocks

Note that up to 10 creatures can wander around a creature box, which you can upgrade up to 30 with the following item
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2519efb7-d4c0-4ad2-9de0-c9ce5205757e)

Creature Boxes also have a range within which creatures can wander around, and, if configured, in which mobs will not spawn. By default, its a radius of 16 blocks, which you can see by right clicking while sneaking, but it can be upgraded to 48 with the following item:
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/de60e7f9-de81-4f03-8746-50c39b1bb3c5)


# Added Dilophosaurus
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/693bb21e-4d57-4ef4-a7bf-34bf73624b64)
* Found in forests
* Has a poisonous spit that poisons and blinds targets, and a claw attack that doesn't do much
* Can be tamed with carnivore meals (and ridden as well)

# New Additions to Spawning System
The following can now be edited for creature spawning
* What structures a creature can spawn in
* What season a creature can spawn on (requires [Serene Seasons](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/serene-seasons))
* What gamestages a player has (requires [Gamestages](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/game-stages))
More details about these will eventually be documented

# Other Changes
* Journal entry unlocking has been reworked, as well as having some more features
  * When you go near a creature, the you will be notified that they have discovered it, which will be logged in your journal
  * Only the creature's art, as well as the foods required to tame it will be visible
  * Upon taming or killing the creature, its entry, its favorite foods for healing, and its usable workstations will be shown
  * Note that for untameable creatures, their journal entry will just be unlocked instead
* Added hints on the lower bottom right of the screen that shows the controls for a creature

...

As always, you will need [Geckolib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/4020277) for 1.12.2 and [LLibrary](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/llibrary/files/3116493) for the mod to run.

# Added Ankyosaurus
![2024-09-04_18 36 58](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a8161209-4045-41ac-9964-18d51ad373fa)
* Found in deserts
* Have an almost invincible shell and a thick club that they use as a weapon
* The shell can only be damaged by explosions
* Upon reaching 25% health, they will hide in the shell, and any attacks towards them will damage anything that hits them, and will regenerate inside
* Can be tamed with herbivore meals (and ridden as well)

# New JSON configs and Spawning System!
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/87f0555c-d384-43a1-9856-1167155fea79)
All the creature specific config files have been revamped, and have since been turned into JSON files! This should be somewhat more convenient (at least on my end)
![imagen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/271762ac-60a1-402d-b2c4-5a33d705d8c2)
In addition, the mod has its own custom spawning system completely separate from vanilla (partially based on bedrock's). From now on, all creatures from the mod will randomly spawn around the player and will keep on spawning until all the creatures reach their density limits (a mob cap might be implemented soon)

# Other Changes
* Locational damage for hitboxes finally implemented!
  * Note that when a mob is being attacked, the hitbox nearest to the attacker will be the one that's hit
* Some improvements to how target selection upon using left click while riding a creature works (especially when shoulder surfing is being utilized)
* When a tamed creature is used to break a block it can break, it will break a 3 x 3 area, with the block being targeted being the bottom (mainly so that you dont trap urself in a hole while riding)
* Added options in the general config where certain creatures will never spawn in a certain radius surrounding spawn (by default 512 blocks) until after a certain number of days (by default 3)

mods.name: Prehistoric Rift
mods.description: Originally made for the Bedrock Edition, this mod aims to add dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures and expand upon gameplay.

releases.notes:
Well whaddya know, at last, a good java port for Prehistoric Rift is out now! Please be reminded that this is very bare bones and not all features in the bedrock version are implemented.

You will need [Forge 1.19.2-43.0.8](https://adfoc.us/serve/sitelinks/?id=271228&url=https://maven.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/1.19.2-43.0.8/forge-1.19.2-43.0.8-installer.jar) and [Geckolib 3.1.16](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/3930006) to play btw.

# Items added
* Raw and Cooked Exotic Meat
* Raw and Boiled Hemolymph
  * Arthropods don't drop it for now, you need to get them from the creative inventory
  * Raw Hemolymph cannot be cooked
* All treats
* Tyrannosaurus Arm

# Mobs added
* Tyrannosaurus
  * Untameable for the time being
  * Can roar when attacked, and while it can do knockback it cant break blocks
  * Cannot spawn naturally for now
  * Cannot pick up items for now
